name: CENNETIC C300-5 Trunnion 5-Axis Machining Center
summary: The C300-5 is a compact trunnion 5-axis machining center for precise simultaneous 5-axis machining of small-to-medium parts, ideal for impellers, fittings and multi-face components.
body:
The C300-5 is a compact trunnion 5-axis machining center for precise simultaneous 5-axis machining of small-to-medium parts, ideal for impellers, fittings and multi-face components.

About this model

This 5-Axis Machining Center is manufactured by our partner factory in Dongguan, China, and supplied direct by CENNETIC with factory-direct pricing, a standard warranty and remote setup support. Specifications are representative and can be confirmed against your machining requirements before order.
